text: Waited 45 minutes for two coffees. Terrible service today.
My cake order was supposed to be ready at 3pm and it wasn't. I had to leave without it. I want a refund.
Found a hair in my sandwich. Not coming back.
The croissants I bought this morning were stale and hard. Very disappointed.
Your staff was really rude to my mom at the counter.
I was charged twice on my card for one order. Please fix this.
The latte was cold and tasted burnt.
Delivery arrived an hour late and the drinks were spilled all over the bag.
Overpriced and tiny portions. Not worth it.
The birthday cake had the wrong name on it. The party is ruined.
Tables were dirty and the restroom had no soap.
I got food poisoning after eating your chicken pesto sandwich yesterday.
Ordered oat milk, got regular milk. I'm lactose intolerant.
Nobody answered my messages about my catering deposit for a week. I want my money back.
The music was so loud we couldn't talk. Ruined our meeting.
Your barista gave me the wrong change and denied it.
Ang tagal ng order namin, halos isang oras. Grabe.
Yung cake na inorder ko, iba yung design sa pinag-usapan natin. Sobrang disappointed ako.
Ang sungit ng cashier niyo kanina. Hindi na ako babalik.
Na-double charge po ako sa GCash. Pakibalik naman po yung sobra.
Matabang yung kape at malamig na nung dumating.
May ipis po sa may table namin kanina. Kadiri.
Ang mahal tapos ang liit ng serving. Sayang pera.
Hindi dumating yung delivery ko, bayad na ako. Refund po please.
Ang dumi ng CR niyo, walang tissue at sabon.
Sumakit tiyan ko after kumain ng pasta niyo kahapon.
Mali yung order na binigay sa akin, tapos ayaw pa palitan.
Ilang beses na ako nag-message tungkol sa deposit ko sa catering, wala pa rin sagot.
Ang ingay sa loob, hindi kami makapag-usap. Sana ayusin niyo.
Expired na pala yung binili kong cold brew. Ano po gagawin niyo dito?
